case.summary: A card-present purchase of $111.92 in billing region 264.0 triggered a high fraud model score of 0.87, leading to a fraud verdict. The customer denied the transaction and still holds the card. Similar past cases involved confirmed fraudulent transactions of comparable amounts in mixed-channel activity. The transaction was declined, verified, and the card was blocked. No device or additional card details were linked. The case aligns with an account takeover pattern, supported by region mismatches and model scoring thresholds.
